title: Vindhya Crossroads
text: A moss-choked crossing where four forest roads meet. A cracked stone shrine to the Drowned Goddess stands at the centre. Travellers leave oil lamps here.

title: The Drowned Lotus Tavern
text: A stilt-house tavern over a black pond. Lotus lanterns glow green. The air smells of smoke and wet cedar. Gossip is the real currency here.

title: Mist Ferry
text: A rope ferry across a wide slow river, run by the ferryman Boran. Fog clings to the water until noon. Smugglers prefer it for the same reason.

title: Kalpur Village
text: A farming village of mud-brick houses and dry wells, led by Headman Dharav. Villagers welcome guests but fiercely protect their headman.

title: Naga Ruins
text: Collapsed temple halls half-swallowed by roots. Serpent carvings line the walls. Something below hums at night.

title: Ashvatha Peak
text: A bare peak crowned by a lone ancient fig tree. Hermits claim the goddess's song can be heard here on windless nights.

title: Mira the Barkeep
text: Sharp-tongued keeper of the Drowned Lotus Tavern and a former River Guard. Dislikes strangers who haggle. Knows every rumour within ten miles.
secret: Mira sealed the Naga Ruins door herself and hid the only key under the tavern's third floorboard.

title: Kavi the Smuggler
text: One-eyed river smuggler with a lotus-shaped eye patch. Charming, evasive, always owes someone money.
secret: Kavi sold a cursed lamp to Headman Dharav and is quietly afraid of what it is doing to him.

title: Headman Dharav
text: Elderly headman of Kalpur Village. Sleepless, hollow-eyed, and often seen muttering to a brass lamp.
secret: The lamp speaks in the goddess's voice, and Dharav plans to free her at the Naga Ruins on the new moon.

title: Sunaina the Hermit
text: A weathered hermit who tends the Crossroads shrine. Speaks in riddles but pays debts. Wants the shrine lamps relit.
secret: Sunaina was the goddess's last priestess and broke her vow once, which is why the lamps are failing.

title: Boran the Ferryman
text: Stoic ferryman who charges two gold a crossing and hates being owed money. Pretends not to see smuggling for a price.

title: The Drowned Goddess
text: The river goddess Jalamaya was bound beneath the Naga Ruins centuries ago. Lamps at shrines keep her dreaming. When lamps go dark, the forest grows restless.

title: Shrine Lamps
text: Shrine lamps burn river-oil. Each lamp lit at a shrine strengthens the binding on Jalamaya. Three lamps at the Crossroads shrine have gone dark this season.

title: The Serpent Guardians
text: Serpent guardians still patrol the Naga Ruins after dusk. They fear fire and respect the river-goddess's sigil.

title: The Flooded Vault
text: Beneath the ruins' main hall lies a flooded vault holding the binding seal: a ring of eight carved lotus petals. Pressing the petals in the order of the old river song (west, north, east, south) re-seals it.

title: Marsh-Wisps
text: Marsh-wisps lure travellers off the ferry road after dark. Lotus lanterns keep them away.

title: The River Guard
text: The River Guard patrolled the forest roads until the lamps began to fail. It was disbanded a few years ago and its veterans scattered.

title: Skill checks
text: Checks are d20 plus a stat against a difficulty: easy 8, normal 12, hard 16. Stats are might, cunning and spirit. The engine rolls; the DM never invents rolls.

title: Damage and healing
text: Light harm costs 2 HP, serious harm 5 HP, brutal harm 8 HP. Resting at an inn heals 5 HP for 2 gold. Apply every change with change_hp.

title: Travel
text: Travel between known locations costs time based on real distance at walking pace. Use move_to; there is no teleporting.
